# BOOK 1: "Out of the Blue" (Bertrand W. Sinclair; Gutenberg 73542; Blue Book Magazine, July 7, 1927)

## Characters
- **Rock Holloway**: young Texan range rider, tall, tanned, gray Stetson, rides sorrel horse **Sangre** (later black pony also his; second horse a bay). Armed (.45 Colt, rifle/carbine). Educated back East; lapsed Eastern degree.
- **"Uncle Bill" Sayre** (William Sayre): Fort Worth Trinity Bank president, ~60, tall thin-faced, drawls "yo'/fo'". Executor of Dave Snell estate. Gives Rock $500 gold "retaining fee" in canvas bag; $60/month.
- **Dave Snell**: dead Maltese Cross owner (~30,000 cattle); children Alice Snell (girl, just 21) and a boy (16). Estate run till boy is 25.
- **Buck Walters**: other executor, Maltese Cross range boss; "young, ambitious, high-handed, fond of women, flashy dresser, stiff poker."
- **Dave Wells**: Texan boss of Steering Wheel (Wagon Wheel) outfit on Old Man River, Canada.
- **Duffys**: Joe, Elmer (Seventy Seven trail boss), Ed, Mark ("Big" Duffy, bully, killed by Rock in Odeen, Clark's Ford). Elmer later proposes marriage to Nona.
- **Al Kerr**: little Texan cowman, Capital K, Judith Basin on Arrow Creek (Lewistown PO); helps Rock with 12 men.
- **Nona Parke**: ~21, dark hair, deep-gray eyes, scarlet lips, TL brand (left rib), ~800 cattle, Marias River ranch. Father (Parke) died after horse fell on him; mother died at Betty's birth.
- **Betty Parke**: ~3, blonde, blue eyes, calls Rock "Doc."
- **Doc Martin**: Nona's dead rider, look-alike of Rock; shot from ambush in river bottom; Rock poses as him at first.
- **Mary Vieux**: half-breed girl, nurse/helper.
- **Charlie Shaw**: 19-20, blue-eyed, TL/Parke rider, loyal; later shot in ravine fight, sent to Benton.
- **Joe Stack** (gunman) and **Bill Hurley**: Walters' hired killers; Hurley shot Doc Martin. Rock forces Stack to talk (burns foot), lets Stack go on Maltese Cross horse.
- **Burris boys**: suspected rustlers behind the Goosebill.
- **Mrs. Mallory/Vernon**, etc. not in this book.

## Events (order)
1. Fort Worth, April: Rock visits Sayre; Sayre hires him to watch Buck Walters on Maltese Cross (Marias River, near Fort Benton). Rock has Seventy Seven job (trail boss Elmer Duffy) north.
2. Clark's Ford, Nebraska, July: Odeon dance hall. Mark Duffy bullies Al Kerr (lifts him onto bar); fires shot at Kerr's feet; Rock intervenes and shoots Duffy dead.
3. Rock rides on; joins Steering Wheel outfit (Canada, Old Man River; Dave Wells boss); winter; spring; Wells's men gather doggies (unbranded-looking cattle with fresh Steering Wheel brand).
4. June: Rock leaves for Fort Benton. Mule-packs for cavalry near Fort Assiniboine.
5. Finds Doc Martin dead in TL ranch (Marias); meets Nona and Betty; buries Doc in canvas beside her parents. Nona hires Rock (~$50/mo, "TL" brand). Elmer Duffy arrives; Rock poses as Doc; Elmer agrees to no feud.
6. Rock meets Maltese Cross round-up with Charlie Shaw and Alice Snell at White Springs; Buck Walters glares.
7. Charlie reveals rustling rumors. Rock learns Nugent-like rumors; Buck wanted Doc out over Alice.
8. Fort Benton: Rock sees Buck & Dave Wells at bar; threatened by Buck ("leave in 48 hours"). Rock asks Charlie about Sweet Grass hidden corrals.
9. Day 48-hour mark: Alice rides up warning of lynch mob (Buck, Elmer, crews); Rock faces them from doorway; Nona vouches; Duffy accepts Rock's identity ("Rock Holloway"); Buck withdraws. Alice shrieks against Buck.
10. Ambush in ravine; Rock shoots Stack's horse, captures Stack and Hurley (Hurley dies). Rock burns Stack's foot to get confession: Buck offered $500 to kill Rock; Hurley shot Doc.
11. Rock tells Nona; kisses her before leaving. Goes to Billings; telegram from Sayre: "Act on your own judgment... Coming north, first train." Rock travels to Capital K; Kerr provides men.
12. Sweet Grass Hills, East Butte: Rock + Charlie spy on hidden corrals (branding pen; Maltese Cross brands reworked into Steering Wheel). Buck, Wells, others branding. Pursuit; Rock kills Buck (carbine, 20 yards) after horse charge; Charlie shot off ledge. Capital K riders arrive.
13. Back at TL: Sayre arrives; Rock tells Nona; Nona says "not sad" — closing line: "there are two times when every woman cries... when she's very happy. And I'm certainly not sad!"

Key quotes: "Out of the blue"—"like lightning out of the blue" (Doc's death). Sangre = sorrel.

# BOOK 2: "A Traitor's Wooing" (Headon Hill; Gutenberg 33453; Ward Lock, 1909; 30 chapters)

## Characters
- **Violet Maynard**: tall, beautiful London-season beauty, daughter of **Montague Maynard**, Birmingham screw manufacturer (millionaire, Harborne villa, Park Lane). Mother dead.
- **Leslie Chermside**: ex-Lieutenant, 24th Lancers, bronzed, Indian debts; bribed by **Bhagwan Singh, Maharajah of Sindkhote** (lustful Indian prince, rejected by Violet at Brabazon House ball) to lure Violet onto steam yacht for abduction to Sindkhote. Falls in love with Violet; confesses nothing fully.
- **Travers Nugent**: smooth London bachelor (Jermyn Street flat; "The Hut," Ottermouth, Devon), fair moustache, close-set blue eyes, "lives on his wits," Maharajah's agent; plots scheme; murdered Levison/indirectly via Legros. Servant **Sinnett** (sphinx-like), chauffeur **Dixon**, Darracq car.
- **Levi Levison**: Jewish "financial agent"/pawnbroker, bought Chermside's Indian debts; murdered on marsh (throat cut, stabbed).
- **Pierre Legros**: French onion-seller from lugger (captain Jules Epitaux); Breton; jealous of Louise; kills Levison; ends by suicide with knife after confession.
- **Louise Aubin**: French maid to Violet; flirts with Levison and Nugent; denounces Chermside.
- **Miss Sarah (Aunt Sarah) Dymmock**: tiny sharp old great-aunt of Violet, wealthy; gives Chermside £250,000 in securities.
- **Vernon Mallory**: retired Foreign Office man, sharp, blind wife **Margaret Mallory**.
- **Enid Mallory** ("Pussy"): his daughter, ~18-20, sprightly; with Reggie.
- **Lieutenant Reginald "Reggie" Beauchamp**: RN, torpedo-boat *Snipe*, mother Mrs. Beauchamp (Lorne Villas), widow of Admiral.
- **Lazarus Lowch**: busybody, funeral-lover, jury foreman; spies through hedge.
- **General Kruse**: "widow's Kruse," drinks.
- **Sergeant Bruce**: local police.
- **Bill Tuke / "The Bootlace Man"**: Nugent's henchman, sells bootlaces, shuts Enid in stone grotto.
- **Captain Simon Brant**: deformed, cruel skipper of steam yacht *Cobra*. **Bully Cheeseman**: mate. **Nettle Jimpson**: Weymouth draper's assistant (Grigg & Wynter), engaged to Ned Parsons (acting gunner, Snipe). Nettle drops cinders in engine (end).
- **Mona Dartring**: Enid's golf friend.
- **Watson**: butler at Manor.

## Plot events (order)
1. London, Brabazon House ball: Bhagwan Singh proposes to Violet, she laughs; Nugent proposes £20,000 plot; Chermside to be sent as lover.
2. Ottermouth (South Devon), August: Chermside arrives; Levison meets Chermside on marsh (demands Indian debt payment). Reggie & Enid clubs. Manor House let furnished to Maynard. Nugent introduced Chermside. Chermside falls for Violet, repents.
3. Luncheon at Manor; Aunt Sarah ejects onion-seller Legros who bullied Louise. Nugent tells Chermside he'll be exposed.
4. Nugent, Sinnett: Legros hired. Levison meets Chermside on marsh; (Levison later killed).
5. Marsh by night: Reggie & Enid hear scream; searchlight from cruiser *Terrible* reveals Chermside.
6. Club: Nugent & Chermside; Levison's body found at picnic-tea pool under railway embankment; "The face in the pool" called from train.
7. Louise reports to Nugent; Nugent feeds Louise lies, she goes to Violet; rose-garden kiss between Chermside & Violet; Louise spies.
8. Inquest at Plume Hotel; Lowch foreman; Reggie questioned.
9. Nugent's *Cobra* (Weymouth; Brant); signal blue then green at Coldbrook Chine.
10. Aunt Sarah gives Chermside securities; sailing; Nugent in club card-room; creaking stair; Mallory/General/Lowch in billiard room overhear.
11. Mallory & Reggie & Enid council (engaged).
12. Louise tells Violet; orangery scene; Violet: "Is that all you have to say to me?"
13. Enid trapped in stone grotto by Tuke; meets Legros; escapes via roof.
14. Nugent to Violet: Chermside fleeing on yacht; she goes to beach at 11; launch takes her to *Cobra*; Chermside fights crew, chained in hold.
15. Nettle Jimpson (stewardess shipped by Brant) befriends Violet; frees Chermside's water; *Snipe* chases; Nettle drops cinders into engines; Brant tries shooting; Nettle's threat; Brant throws Derringer overboard.
16. Epilogue: Violet/Chermside engaged; Nugent killed by Legros; Legros suicide; Lowch engaged to Louise; Nettle gets Grigg & Wynter business.

Quoted: "A screw loose somewhere" (Reggie's pun); "Sindkhote"; "the Cobra" "sleeping snake"; "Advance" (signal word).
